findings.one_line: The stated claim that every proper intervention breaks the cycle is false if the empty intervention is a proper subset: it leaves the cycle intact; state and use a nonempty proper intervention.

The advertised two-district stress-test is not reproducible: its target uses do(S=0), do(S=1), but S is the source set and no endogenous S or link from the perturbed response-table event to that target is defined; hence it does not establish the claimed 1/3-to-3/8 transmission witness.

cited_checks.note: The supplied verbatim Theorem 5 statement gives exactly the iff between counterfactual identification from the supplied distributions/graph and ctfID returning an expression; the core uses only its acyclic finite-SCM restriction.
